actions.action: Watch for white, tan or brown sunburn patches and move the plant back a step if they appear
Check whether the soil stays damp from fuchsia drip and move one plant if it does
Week 1: keep in bright shade or give about 1 hour of direct morning sun
Every 3-5 days, move to a spot with about one more hour of sun, morning first, working up to 4-6 hours
Water thoroughly only when soil is completely dry a couple of inches down
Bring the plant indoors before nights drop below about 40°F (5°C)
Lay dropped leaves on dry soil to root new plants
